overview.en:
Review local code changes with CodeRabbit's official CLI and safely triage or apply unresolved CodeRabbit GitHub PR feedback through the official code-review and autofix skills.

Review local changes and repository feedback with the original diff in view. Separate actionable findings from questions and prepare focused fixes.

Use this plugin in a Ghast conversation with the relevant inputs or project context. The bundled workflow guides the task; any required external tools or runtime must be available in your environment.
overview.zh-CN:
审查本地代码变更，整理和处理 GitHub 拉取请求中的代码审查反馈。

结合原始差异审查本地变更与仓库反馈，区分可执行发现与待确认问题，并准备有针对性的修复。

在 Ghast 对话中提供相关输入或项目背景后使用本插件。随附流程会指导任务；所需外部工具或运行环境仍需在本机可用。

starterPrompts.en: Review my current diff and list the most important findings.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 审查我当前的代码差异，列出最重要的发现。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the review feedback on this pull request.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个拉取请求的审查反馈。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare focused fixes for these confirmed review findings.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这些已确认审查问题准备有针对性的修复。
